question: What state of consciousness is associated with the devoted great-souled one?
premises: A great-souled one is endowed with devotion.
Wine-bliss-consciousness is named in this context.
The devotional state is linked to that consciousness.
inference: The devoted great-souled one is associated with the consciousness of wine-bliss.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of mahātmanaḥ in the larger sentence is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: The consciousness of wine-bliss belongs to the devoted great-souled one.
